info.title: Community Giving API
info.description:
Core API for the Community Giving Platform. Owns all money logic; the only service with PayPal credentials.

* Money is integer minor units in fields ending in `_cents`, with a currency code (USD).
* Errors are `{"detail": {"error": CODE, "message": text}}`.
* Routes not built yet return their example response with an `X-Stub` header (or **501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED** when `STUB_EXAMPLES=false`). Don't treat their data as real.
* `/admin/*` needs `Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>`; `/internal/*` (agents) needs `Bearer <INTERNAL_TOKEN>`.

Projected match while the round is open (recomputed every 5 minutes); final once the round closes.

Projects whose matching the Watchdog froze are listed with a match of 0 and `matching_frozen: true`.

clear: a false alarm, matching resumes. confirm: the evidence's donor_ids count as one person
in matching, and matching resumes. confirm + remove_project: the project is delisted and its
matching stays frozen; refund its donations in PayPal and the refund webhooks update the totals.

get.description: Mandates for the Giving Agent's run, with each donor's remaining funded balance.

post.description: The Giving Agent records its candidates, scores and choices before requesting donations.

Re-checks budget, per-project max, exclusions and project status, then records the gift
(target_type AGENT) or parks it for the donor's approval. Never calls PayPal.

Asking twice for the same run and project returns the first answer, so agent retries are safe.

Watchdog rule hit: opens a case and freezes the project's matching (not its donations).

The same rule firing again on a project with an open case returns that case instead of a new one.

Milestone Agent: all checks pass, no open Watchdog case and the tranche (including its match)
is at most MILESTONE_AUTO_RELEASE_CENTS -> released; otherwise held for an admin.
Agents log decisions that don't go through another endpoint (e.g. a skipped project).

Verifies the signature, skips repeats by event id, then handles PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED,
.PENDING, .DENIED, .REFUNDED and .REVERSED. Other types are recorded as ignored.
